layered_verdict.explanation: PLAN_SAFE: the checker now proves overwrite safety against the full partial order (ALL readers must be transitive predecessors), independent of the reuse_of annotation, with counterexample tests. STATIC_EVAL_READY: STREAM (pinned commit 75748cc) ran natively and on the Qwen MLP; results are evaluation_kind=analytical_static, never claimed as runtime. RUNTIME_READY: no execution backend exists; ONNXim adapter is explicitly NOT IMPLEMENTED and the runner is fail-closed, so nothing fabricated a runtime result.

base_note: Round-1 HEAD (verdict PARTIAL). Round-1 handoff archived as handoff_2026-09-09_round1.json / handoff_2026-09-09_round1_to_chatgpt.md.

A1_checker_reuse_safety.before: checker accepted an overwrite of slot A if the writer waited for ANY ONE of A's readers (any(reader in predecessors)); a plan where Q overwrites A after only R1 (but not R2) was accepted.
A1_checker_reuse_safety.after: check_overwrite_safety does a pairwise scan over same-(level,core,slot) byte-range overlaps and requires dead_before(old,new): EVERY reader of the old value (including EXTERNAL/initial-resident) must be a transitive predecessor of the new writer, using deps-derived reachability only (never static_order).
A1_checker_reuse_safety.counterexample: P writes A; R1,R2 read A; Q overwrites A's slot. Old code: deps Q<-{P,R1} ACCEPTED (bug). New code: REJECTED unless both R1 and R2 precede Q.

A2_slot_model_and_structure.alias_derivation: overwrite/alias is derived from actual (level, core, slot, byte_range) overlap via Chunk.byte_range()/overlaps(); reuse_of is now only checked for annotation consistency, never used as the safety source.
A2_slot_model_and_structure.order_semantics_distinction: check.safety_scope separates 'dependency_and_overwrite_safety: all executions consistent with deps' from 'capacity_peak: declared static_order only - not a hardware peak under arbitrary interleaving'. static_order itself is validated to be a true topological order (static_order_not_topological).
A2_slot_model_and_structure.naive_generator_barrier: naive_layered_plan previously wired silu/mul/cast against a growing prefix of the previous stage; now silu.{j} deps = ALL gate ops, mul.{j} deps = ALL silu + ALL up ops, cast.{j} deps = ALL mul ops (true whole-layer barrier). Verified by test_naive_is_a_true_whole_layer_barrier. Plan identity changed dbe43cc256081c5a -> d3a4c6c861535e7f and edges 1170 -> 1476 as an honest consequence.
A2_slot_model_and_structure.structural_validation: new check_structure validates: duplicate op/chunk ids, core range, chunk-key vs producer consistency, valid memory level, positive size, non-negative offset, producer/writes bidirectional uniqueness, consumer read-source existence, EXTERNAL/initial-resident consistency. Missing dep references produce a structured rejection (unknown_dependency), never KeyError/RecursionError (test_unknown_dep_is_a_structured_rejection_not_a_crash).
A2_slot_model_and_structure.renames: summary field resident_bytes_by_level renamed to resident_value_bytes_sum (documented: sum of logical value sizes placed on-chip; NOT traffic, NOT saved DRAM bytes, NOT a peak).

A3_fail_closed_runner.fail_closed: run_plans checks each plan first; check.ok==False -> backend.execute is NEVER called (entry backend={'skipped':'check_failed'}); spy-backend test asserts zero calls (test_illegal_plan_never_reaches_the_backend). Rejection reasons surface identically in CLI output and manifest admission.illegal_plans.
A3_fail_closed_runner.onnxim_adapter: OnnximBackend.execution_adapter_implemented=False; execute() raises BackendUnavailable stating the adapter is NOT IMPLEMENTED; probe_environment() does a LIVE host probe (binary/cmake/conan) separated from historical 2026-09-09 blockers; source-audit capability findings are labelled source_only.
A3_fail_closed_runner.run_dir: new run directories refuse overwrite (test_run_directory_is_never_overwritten, test_new_run_dir_is_unique).
A3_fail_closed_runner.identities: manifest v2 records workload/contract/hardware/backend/policy as separate content identities (hashes); plan_id is a plan identity, not the whole-experiment identity (test_run_identities_are_separate).

A4_expressiveness_layering.three_layers: plan/lowering.py: logical_semantics (checker) -> backend_expressibility (per-feature source-audit verdicts) -> physical_lowering (READY/NOT_READY). assess_plan combines all three into admission.
A4_expressiveness_layering.remote_reads: resident_pipelined has 134 remote on-chip reads (down.* reads A16#k from other cores) with no movement contract -> physical_lowering_status=NOT_READY with explicit reason; a remote read is never free. Verified by test_resident_plan_remote_reads_block_physical_lowering.
A4_expressiveness_layering.permutation_use_case: generators.permute_plan_cores(plan, permutation) is a legal core-mapping control case: only core fields change, checker still passes (test_core_permutation_is_a_legal_mapping_control_case).
A4_expressiveness_layering.numeric_licence: generators._numeric_replay_meta attaches schema/shape-slice/layout/op-semantics/dtype/tolerance metadata so a plan carries enough info for functional replay.
A4_expressiveness_layering.functional_replay: analysis/plan_replay.py: PlanReplay walks a deps-derived topological order, honours physical slot overwrite semantics, and compares against an independent float64 oracle (oracle_mlp). No cycles, no bandwidth, no fabricated timing. Mutations caught: wrong shard source, omitted cast, broken reuse (checker), premature overwrite (slot guard).
